# TrivianEdge

> TrivianEdge is a Toronto-based technology partner with three service lines: Microsoft and Google cloud (Microsoft 365, Copilot, Azure, Google Workspace, Google Cloud), AI and custom software development, and offshore teams (BPO, RPO, and engineering) from six talent hubs, typically live in about 30 days.

TrivianEdge is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. It is a member of the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program (Partner ID 7154428); it is not a Microsoft CSP or Solutions Partner. It delivers Google Workspace and Google Cloud projects but is not a Google partner. Talent hubs: the Philippines, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Turkey, South Africa, and Costa Rica. TrivianEdge works with in-country employer-of-record and payroll partners, so clients can hire in those countries without setting up a foreign entity. Offshore teams usually cost up to 40% less than hiring locally in Canada, the US, or the UK.

## Cloud

- [Microsoft & Google cloud services](https://www.trivianedge.com/services#microsoft-cloud): Microsoft 365 and Copilot rollout, Azure migration and cost review, Google Workspace migration (either direction), Google Cloud architecture, identity, MFA, and security baselines.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.trivianedge.com/services): Every TrivianEdge service line in one place.
- [BPO](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/bpo): Business Process Outsourcing — offshore back-office, customer support, finance, and HR admin teams.
- [RPO](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/rpo): Recruitment Process Outsourcing — embedded hiring, sourcing, screening, and onboarding.
  - [Full-Cycle RPO](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/rpo/full-cycle-rpo): Ongoing, embedded recruitment function for continuous hiring needs.
  - [Project-Based RPO](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/rpo/project-based-rpo): Defined, time-boxed hiring sprints for launches, funding rounds, and seasonal peaks.
  - [AI-Powered Recruitment](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/rpo/ai-powered-recruitment): AI-assisted sourcing and screening, with every shortlist reviewed by a human recruiter.
- [Bespoke Software Development](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/it-outsourcing): Custom applications and platforms built by dedicated offshore engineering teams, plus the IT outsourcing layer around them — cloud/DevOps, QA, cybersecurity, and systems integration.
- [AI Development](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/ai-development): Offshore AI engineering — generative AI, LLM integration, machine learning, and MLOps.
  - [Generative AI Development](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/ai-development/generative-ai): RAG systems, AI copilots, and content generation tools grounded in your own data.
  - [LLM Integration & Fine-Tuning](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/ai-development/llm-integration): Integrating and fine-tuning OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and open-source models.
  - [Machine Learning & Data Science](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/ai-development/machine-learning): Predictive models, forecasting, and recommendation engines from your own data.
  - [AI Automation Pipelines](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/ai-development/ai-automation): Document intelligence and agentic workflows integrated with your existing systems.
  - [AI Chatbot Development](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/ai-development/ai-chatbot-development): Custom support, sales, and internal assistants grounded in your own knowledge base.
  - [MLOps & AI Infrastructure](https://www.trivianedge.com/services/ai-development/mlops): Deployment, drift monitoring, and cost optimization for production AI/ML.

- [EOR vs. Foreign Entity](https://www.trivianedge.com/compare/eor-vs-foreign-entity): Employer-of-record partnerships versus registering your own foreign legal entity.
- [AI Development Agency vs. In-House AI Team](https://www.trivianedge.com/compare/ai-development-agency-vs-in-house-team): Outsourced AI engineering versus hiring a permanent in-house AI/ML team.

## Talent Hubs

- [Philippines](https://www.trivianedge.com/talent/philippines): Operational and service excellence — customer support, back-office, and finance ops talent.
- [Sri Lanka](https://www.trivianedge.com/talent/sri-lanka): High-end software engineering — full-stack, data, and cloud engineers.
- [Vietnam](https://www.trivianedge.com/talent/vietnam): Next-gen tech and development — AI/ML engineers and modern backend talent.
- [Turkey](https://www.trivianedge.com/talent/turkey): Strategic bridge operations and tech, aligned to EU/UK working hours.
- [South Africa](https://www.trivianedge.com/talent/south-africa): Financial and specialized operations talent, aligned to UK/EU working hours.
- [Costa Rica](https://www.trivianedge.com/talent/costa-rica): Premium nearshore tech talent, aligned to US Central/Eastern time zones.
